title: PAH-OMC-020 conditional chain coverage audit
question: Do the current R-537, R-538, R-555 and R-557 authorities cover every logical implication from fixed-n J and anchored-n D inputs to the requested j-before-n compact-time local-correlation conclusion, leaving only source-owned antecedents missing?
method: Replay the R-537 common-core Duhamel transfer with its canonical pinned Lean cache.
Replay the R-538 Mosco/resolvent conditional selection, R-555 nested ordered-epsilon bridge and R-557 ten-field owner-packet sufficiency verifier.
Crosswalk each conclusion and missing antecedent against the original PAH-OMC-020 preregistered model, external stochastic time and j-before-anchored-n order.
Do not add a carrier, comparison map, rate, state, counterterm, limit or physical interpretation; treat current integrated run hashes as provenance data only.
finding: The conditional logical chain is complete at its declared tier. R-537 gives the common-core variation-of-constants envelope with initial defect I_n and residual R_n; R-538 gives the conditional R-512 resolvent selection once common-space liminf/recovery/norm inputs exist; R-555 proves the exact nested j-before-n epsilon implication from J_(n,j) and D_n; and R-557 verifies that one compatible ten-field packet plus those estimates is sufficient. Current replays pass R-537 22/22, R-538 23/23, R-555 22/22 and R-557 22/22. None of the source-authorized antecedents is present, so the actual PAH-OMC-020 convergence theorem remains unproved.
decision_reason: This audit closes a proof-coverage question without promoting a conditional implication. It shows that the remaining gap is an owner-input and uniform-estimate cut-set, not an unexamined abstract epsilon, Duhamel or Mosco lemma.
boundary: PAH-001, its original functional, rates, labelled Gibbs state, normalization, external stochastic Markov time, finite carrier and j-before-anchored-n order are unchanged. No successor dynamics, direct sum, conditional averaging, replacement carrier or physical interpretation is introduced.
verification_summary: R-537 integrated 22/22; R-538 integrated 23/23; R-555 integrated 22/22; R-557 integrated 22/22. All are conditional/auxiliary and preserve explicit missing owner fields and non-claims.
next_action: Keep PAH-OMC-020 active at the owner-packet cut-set. Reopen the full convergence proof only when the ten fields and source-authorized J/D antecedents are hash-pinned; then instantiate this already verified chain without changing PAH-001.
revisit_condition: Reopen on one complete source-authorized packet, a genuine PAH parent-byte change, or an exact contradiction to one conditional implication. Do not repeat the same abstract chain while its antecedents remain absent.
non_claims: This audit does not prove the PAH-specific fixed-n J limit, anchored-n D limit or R-512 minimal-form identification.
It does not prove full PAH-OMC-020 semigroup convergence or refute every owner-fixed successor.
Current integrated run hashes may require provenance refresh after later Lean registrations; this does not alter the conditional mathematics.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum, Yang-Mills, mass-gap or TOE conclusion is made; external Markov time remains stochastic bookkeeping.
